title: WP photo Retry compares verified native readback and grants a fixed explicit Retry window
steps: Run the three declared Node test suites.
expect: Verified legacy photo snapshots reconcile only known timestamps and synthetic featured media, with exact full raw equality plus live REST featured proof.
Real content changes, missing receipts and featured-media drift remain blocked. New snapshots use stable semantic hashes across JSONB member ordering.
Retry accepted immediately before or at original deadline retains its fixed bounded window without new spend allowance.
fence: Original snapshots and counters stay unchanged; native readback, current scope and uncertain attempt protections remain.
